_help: Bot brain numbers (SPEC 9). Edit and relaunch play.bat.
difficulty: per level. memoryAccuracy is the chance a remembered room or time is exact (SPEC 9.12).
memorySpanMeetings: how many meetings back a bot remembers; null means unlimited.
perception: what counts as 'with someone', 'at a task spot', 'near a body', in tiles.
claims.windowSec: how far back an alibi like 'i was in Medbay' is taken to cover.
claims.contradictionMinSec: how long my sighting must clash with a claim before I call it a contradiction.
recall.roomBlurNeighbours: a misremembered room becomes a neighbouring one. recall.timeBlurSec: a misremembered time shifts by up to this.
difficulty.impostorFaking: sloppy / good / perfect. killCaution: onlyAlone (nobody in sight at all), normal (nobody could see), tracksWitnesses (normal plus self-reports and framing).
difficulty.crossCheckClaims: chance a bot checks a claim against its memory. playerTargeting: random / normal / prioritize (the player when the player has accused it).
crew.buddy: how long (seconds) a buddying stretch lasts and how close to stay. crew.fear: top suspect within this many tiles with nobody else near makes a bot walk to company.
